entries.candidate: China Unicom Hohhot Cloud Data Base (中国联通呼和浩特云数据基地) / China Unicom Northwest (Hohhot) Base (中国联通西北（呼和浩特）基地), Xincheng District, Hohhot: 2026 expansion served by the 3# 220 kV substation
entries.reason: On 28 August 2026 the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment published the approval result for the EIA of the 2026 China Unicom Hohhot Cloud Data Base 3# 220 kV substation (local nmg-cu-hohhot-3-220kv-20260828.html). The 75 MB report attachment (P020260828373522698772.doc, 75,111,351 bytes) is the only source likely to print a coordinate. A capture with a copy of capture.mjs with its timeout raised to 1,200 s timed out on 23 October 2026 (metadata nmg-cu-hohhot-3-220kv-eia-report-20260828.doc.metadata.json); the host serves HTTP 206 range responses at about 0.1 MB/s. The Hohhot EEB approved the base's 2# 110 kV substation on 25 February 2026 (呼环政批字〔2026〕17号, local hh-cu-cloudbase-2-110kv-approval-20260305.pdf), building unit 联通云数据有限公司呼和浩特市分公司, location given only as Xincheng District, with its line running to a tunnel joint outside the China Unicom Northwest (Hohhot) Base. It also approved a second 110 kV substation for the Northwest base (26 February 2026). Both approvals are outside the window and ancillary. No non-ancillary in-window record naming a data-centre phase was found: the Xincheng District portal (www.xinchengqu.gov.cn) and www.chinaunicom.com.cn failed to connect. The campus is not in the Atlas or any hold.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within the window) primary record naming a China Unicom Hohhot data-centre phase or the operating base (district, operator or permit record), plus a sourced coordinate. The 3# 220 kV substation report, if captured in full, could supply the coordinate and say which data-centre load it serves.

entries.candidate: China Telecom Cloud Computing Inner Mongolia Information Park (中国电信云计算内蒙古信息园), Horinger: new in-window operating statement (cn-north-p1 hold)
entries.reason: New evidence for the cn-north-p1 hold. The New Area approvals bureau's 15 September 2026 item (local hl-news-t20260915_2036494.html) says the information park recovers data-centre waste heat with water-source heat pumps, and that a single machine building can heat about 360,000 m2. The locator is still unresolved. The Hohhot EEB-accepted 110 kV substation EIA (June 2025) prints E 111°49'50.368", N 40°32'17.373". It says the station's north side adjoins the information park (变电站站址北侧紧邻中国电信云计算内蒙古信息园) and that its south, west and east sides are vacant land, so the point lies just outside the 1,422.3-mu park's south edge, not on the campus.
entries.reopen_condition: An official on-campus coordinate or parcel for the information park (for example an EIA for an in-park substation, a planning board with coordinates), or an explicit review accepting a campus-edge adjacent point; then admit existing operations with the 15 September 2026 statement while it is within 85 days (to 9 December 2026).
